name: gNBSim (OMEC/SD-Core)
description: gNB simulator from the Aether/SD-Core project. Simulates gNodeB and UE by generating NAS and NGAP messages for configured UEs and call flows.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Dockerfile present in repository root. Designed for deployment as a standalone container.

eval_notes: Actively maintained gNB/UE simulator. Good for testing 5G core registration, PDU session, and handover procedures. Docker-ready for containerized test environments. Purpose-built for testing 5G core control plane. Profile-based testing with parallel/sequential execution. ICMP echo for user plane validation. Good for structured 5GC testing evals.
